text:
sam: FYI i found a mismatch in the dedicated/provisioning eviction example  docs show `evict: false` but runtime ignores that key

olivia: link to the PR?

sam: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5230  i pushed a small change but CI flagged linkcheck failures

sam: here's the failing snippet from the migration guide:
```yaml
capacity_pool:
  reserved: true
  evict: false
  labels: ["tenant:reporting"]
```

runtime-bot: runtime schema expects `eviction_policy: NO_EVICT` and `isolation_decorators` (list of maps) instead of `evict`/`labels`

olivia: ok. plan: 1) update YAML examples to runtime schema, 2) add a one-line migration table mapping old->new keys, 3) include a short Python SDK snippet and mark codeblock language

sam: drafting Python snippet now:
```python
from redwood.dedicated import CapacityPool
pool = CapacityPool(reserved=True, eviction_policy="NO_EVICT", isolation_decorators=[{"tenant":"reporting"}])
client.create_capacity_pool(pool)
```

docs-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/eviction-migrate-5230

ci-bot: linkcheck: /docs/dedicated#capacity-anchors missing (404 anchor). docs-lint: codeblock missing language tag for python snippet

olivia: i'll update the anchor and add the language tag. also add the migration note: "map `evict` -> `eviction_policy`; `labels` -> `isolation_decorators` to preserve scheduling behavior."

sam: i'll also add a one-line regression item to the docs release checklist and link a tiny runtime test once the test PR lands

sam: tagging @olivia for final review, would like to ship this afternoon :thumbsup:
